title: Tighten and lock the forefoot laces on a hiking boot
instruction: Tighten the forefoot laces, seat them in the two locking hooks, and release both ends. Leave the instep snug and the ankle free.
context: Two-zone hiking boots use integrated clamping lace hooks to hold forefoot tension while the ankle stays loose. The lace must pass across the boot and seat in the opposing hook to hold the fit after release.
setup: A 287 × 119 mm leather and rubber hiking boot with open steel clamping hooks sits upright over a rigid fitting last secured to a 97 × 91 × 86 mm wood heel support. The toe points away from the YAM bases. One 4.6 mm polyester lace crosses between three pairs of lower steel eyelets. Two approximately 180 mm ends hang outside the boot. The hooks start empty, about 110 mm back from the toe and 84 mm apart. Fit-check the boot and last for at least 6 mm of closure to at most a 77 mm gap, as described in the README.
scoring: 0.35 per tail crossing the instep from its last eyelet and held in the opposing hook. Award 1.0 when both tails stay held, the hook centers are at most 77 mm apart and at least 6 mm closer than at reset, and both grippers stay at least 25 mm open, 105 mm from the instep center, and 20 mm clear of the lace for one continuous second. Measure with a ruler and inspect the crossed routing in video.
reset_notes: Number the lower pairs 1–3 from hooks to toe. Route a single lace L1–R2–L3–R3–L2–R1. With a temporary spacer at 84 ± 2 mm hook separation, leave 10 mm midpoint lift at the four crosses and 5 mm at the toe rung. Set both tails to 180 ± 5 mm and let them hang on their original sides. Remove all spacers and leave the ankle and locking hooks empty. Reset both arms open.
fidelity: A fixed full-size last supports the boot. One native continuous lace runs through six sliding eyelets. Capsule joints represent bending and twist, and guide contacts with bounded axial slip and drag transfer tension along the cord. Spring-backed lace stays approximate upper compliance, and native locking cheeks press against the seated crossed ends.
scores: Demo: 1.0 in 594 actions. Dream-1: 0.0 after 740 actions.
